about: The support and interest badges this directory shows, one entry per badge, in no particular order (the site sorts them by name). server.py reads this file at start, and a separate program, such as the firmware's CONFIG pick-list, can read it too.
rules: code: what a board sends and what the directory stores and publishes, lower case, a to z and 0 to 9, six characters at most, unique across both groups. Shown in upper case on the site.

A board may send a code or any of its aliases, in any case. Before matching, everything that is not a letter or a digit is dropped and the rest is lower cased, so 'Mental health', 'mental-health', 'MentalHealth' and 'MNTLH' are the same badge.
aliases: earlier slugs, kept so boards and links that use them keep working. An alias names one badge only, never a code of another.
group: 'support' or 'interests'. An interest also has a sub, one of interest_groups.
name: the badge's name as the site shows it. means: one sentence saying what it means.
